assets.title: Access point
assets.description: A ceiling-mount Wi-Fi access point seen from below, with a green status light and three teal signal arcs.
assets.use: Map sprite for a placed AP (FR-002). Pair it with a channel badge so the channel is never colour-only.

assets.title: Access point placement preview
assets.description: A dashed, see-through outline of an access point, shown where the map cursor would place one.
assets.use: Ghost sprite under the map cursor while placing an AP; swap to the solid sprite on confirm.

assets.title: Access point with channel conflict
assets.description: An access point whose signal arcs clash with orange zig-zag arcs, plus an orange warning triangle with an exclamation mark.
assets.use: Map sprite when an AP has at least one conflicting neighbour (FR-007). Show the effective capacity number beside it.

assets.title: Overloaded access point
assets.description: An access point with a gauge above it whose needle is pushed past the red end of the scale.
assets.use: Map sprite when an AP's users demand more than its capacity (FR-009). Show the utilisation % beside it.

assets.title: 100 Mbps uplink
assets.description: A single network cable plug with a label reading 100M.
assets.use: Building uplink icon for the $200 100 Mbps option (FR-003).

assets.title: 1 Gbps uplink
assets.description: A thicker double fibre cable with a gold connector and a label reading 1G.
assets.use: Building uplink icon for the $800 1 Gbps option or an upgrade (FR-003).

assets.title: Failed uplink
assets.description: A grey network cable cut in two, with a spark in the gap and a red cross, labelled DOWN.
assets.use: Uplink icon after a scheduled failure (FR-011, Level 3). Pair it with the grey 'Uplink down' zone overlay.

assets.title: Campus core switch
assets.description: A rack-mounted network switch with eight ports, each with a small status light.
assets.use: Where building uplinks terminate; good for the network-closet panel or the uplink purchase dialog.

assets.title: Channel 1 badge
assets.description: A round badge showing the number 1. Solid fill: one of the three non-overlapping 2.4 GHz channels.
assets.use: Badge drawn beside an AP and in the zone table so the channel is readable as a number (FR-007, FR-035).

assets.title: Channel 2 badge
assets.description: A round badge showing the number 2. White with a dashed outline: an overlapping channel.
assets.use: Badge drawn beside an AP and in the zone table so the channel is readable as a number (FR-007, FR-035).

assets.title: Library
assets.description: A classical brick-and-cream campus library with four columns, a round window and front steps.
assets.use: Level 1 'Orientation Week' building and briefing art (FR-031).

assets.title: Dormitory
assets.description: A four-storey brick dorm with lit and unlit windows and a stack of moving boxes by the door.
assets.use: Level 2 'Dorm Move-In' building and briefing art (FR-031).

assets.title: Stadium
assets.description: A top-down oval stadium with grey stands, a green field with yard lines, and teal and amber end zones.
assets.use: Level 3 'Homecoming' stadium (FR-031).

assets.title: Student center
assets.description: A modern student center with a glass front, an amber entrance canopy and a red flag on the roof.
assets.use: Level 3 student center, the building with the scheduled uplink failure (FR-031).

assets.title: Grass tile
assets.description: A square of campus lawn with a few grass tufts.
assets.use: Map cell outside any building. One tile = one 5 m x 5 m cell (FR-001).

assets.title: Footpath tile
assets.description: A square of sandy paving with rounded stones.
assets.use: Map cell for campus walkways between buildings.

assets.title: Indoor floor tile
assets.description: Light floor tiles in a 2 x 2 grid, used inside buildings.
assets.use: Map cell for a zone inside a building (FR-001).

assets.title: Playing field tile
assets.description: Bright turf with a white yard line.
assets.use: Map cell inside the stadium (Level 3).

assets.title: Map cursor
assets.description: Four thick corner brackets that frame one map cell.
assets.use: Keyboard map cursor and current selection (FR-036). High contrast, so it works on every tile.

assets.title: Not covered overlay
assets.description: A see-through tile with dark diagonal hatching and a small crossed-out Wi-Fi symbol.
assets.use: Draw over a zone whose RSSI is below -67 dBm (FR-006). The hatching shows coverage without relying on colour.

assets.title: Congested overlay
assets.description: A see-through tile with bold amber chevrons, like a slow-traffic road marking.
assets.use: Draw over zones served by an overloaded AP or a congested uplink (FR-009, FR-010).

assets.title: Uplink down overlay
assets.description: A grey see-through tile with a dotted grid and a small broken-plug symbol.
assets.use: Draw over every zone in a building with no working uplink; users show grey 'Uplink down' status (Level 3).

assets.title: Open-ticket zone overlay
assets.description: A tile outlined with a pink dashed border and a small ticket in the corner.
assets.use: Marks the zone that an open trouble ticket belongs to (FR-014).

assets.title: Drywall wall segment
assets.description: A pale wall segment with dashed vertical seams between panels.
assets.use: Wall on a cell edge; 3 dB loss in the model (FR-005, illustrative).

assets.title: Brick wall segment
assets.description: A red brick wall segment in a running-bond pattern.
assets.use: Wall on a cell edge; 8 dB loss in the model (FR-005, illustrative).

assets.title: Concrete wall segment
assets.description: A thick grey concrete wall segment with diagonal hatching and aggregate speckles.
assets.use: Wall on a cell edge; 12 dB loss in the model (FR-005, illustrative).

assets.title: Light user
assets.description: A student with short dark hair holding an open laptop.
assets.use: Map sprite for a Light user: browsing and email, 2 Mbps (FR-008).

assets.title: Video user
assets.description: A student in a cap holding a phone that shows a play button.
assets.use: Map sprite for a Video user: streaming, 5 Mbps (FR-008).

assets.title: Event user
assets.description: A fan with curly hair waving an amber pennant.
assets.use: Map sprite for an Event user at Homecoming: 3 Mbps (FR-008, Level 3).

assets.title: Help-desk technician
assets.description: A technician with a bun, wearing a headset and holding a clipboard.
assets.use: Optional character for hint panels or the ticket queue header.

assets.title: Satisfied status badge
assets.description: A green circle with a white check mark.
assets.use: Small badge over a user or zone at 100% satisfaction.

assets.title: Slow status badge
assets.description: An amber triangle with an exclamation mark.
assets.use: Small badge over a user or zone below 100% satisfaction.

assets.title: Offline status badge
assets.description: A grey square with a white cross.
assets.use: Small badge over a user who gets 0 Mbps (not covered or uplink down).

assets.title: Diagnosis: Weak signal
assets.description: A Wi-Fi symbol with only the smallest arc solid; the two outer arcs are grey and dashed, with a down arrow.
assets.use: Diagnosis option button for 'Weak signal' (zone RSSI below -67 dBm).

assets.title: Diagnosis: AP overloaded
assets.description: A small access point under a crowd of three heads, with a gauge needle in the red.
assets.use: Diagnosis option button for 'AP overloaded' (users demand more than 100 Mbps).

assets.title: Diagnosis: Uplink congested
assets.description: A funnel packed with coloured traffic dots, squeezing into a thin pipe.
assets.use: Diagnosis option button for 'Uplink congested' (building traffic above uplink capacity).

assets.title: Diagnosis: Channel interference
assets.description: Two overlapping wave lines, one teal and one orange, with a lightning bolt where they cross.
assets.use: Diagnosis option button for 'Channel interference' (AP conflict and utilisation above effective capacity).

assets.title: Diagnosis: Uplink down
assets.description: A cable broken into two pieces with a red cross between them.
assets.use: Diagnosis option button for 'Uplink down' (building has no working uplink).

assets.title: Open ticket
assets.description: A pink paper trouble ticket with an orange circle and exclamation mark.
assets.use: Ticket queue row icon for an open ticket (FR-014).

assets.title: Ticket diagnosed, awaiting fix
assets.description: A trouble ticket with a blue circle holding a wrench.
assets.use: Ticket status 'Diagnosed - awaiting fix'. The ticket is still open and still ageing (FR-017, FR-020).

assets.title: Closed ticket
assets.description: A trouble ticket with a green circle and a check mark.
assets.use: Ticket status when the zone reaches 100% satisfaction after a correct diagnosis (FR-017).

assets.title: Ticket resolved by network change
assets.description: A trouble ticket with a grey gear, meaning the network change fixed it before a diagnosis.
assets.use: Ticket status 'Resolved by network change' (FR-017a). No diagnosis points.

assets.title: Scheduled maintenance risk
assets.description: A calendar page with a hazard triangle and a wrench.
assets.use: Warning shown in the Level 3 briefing and Wave 2 preview before the uplink failure (US5 scenario 5).

assets.title: Signal strength 0 of 4
assets.description: Four rising bars with 0 filled in teal.
assets.use: Compact RSSI indicator for the zone panel. Always show the dBm number next to it (FR-035).

assets.title: Signal strength 1 of 4
assets.description: Four rising bars with 1 filled in teal.
assets.use: Compact RSSI indicator for the zone panel. Always show the dBm number next to it (FR-035).

assets.title: Signal strength 2 of 4
assets.description: Four rising bars with 2 filled in teal.
assets.use: Compact RSSI indicator for the zone panel. Always show the dBm number next to it (FR-035).

assets.title: Signal strength 3 of 4
assets.description: Four rising bars with 3 filled in teal.
assets.use: Compact RSSI indicator for the zone panel. Always show the dBm number next to it (FR-035).

assets.title: Signal strength 4 of 4
assets.description: Four rising bars with 4 filled in teal.
assets.use: Compact RSSI indicator for the zone panel. Always show the dBm number next to it (FR-035).

assets.title: Pause
assets.description: Two vertical bars.
assets.use: Pause button; Space key (FR-021).

assets.title: Play
assets.description: A right-pointing triangle.
assets.use: Resume button (FR-021).

assets.title: Normal speed
assets.description: One triangle followed by 1x.
assets.use: Clock speed 1x (FR-021).

assets.title: Double speed
assets.description: Two triangles followed by 2x.
assets.use: Clock speed 2x (FR-021).

assets.title: Auto-pause setting
assets.description: A pause symbol inside a circle with a small letter A.
assets.use: Toggle for auto-pause on tickets and reviews (FR-022).

assets.title: Hint
assets.description: A lit light bulb.
assets.use: Hint button: method first, then worked solution (FR-019).

assets.title: Budget
assets.description: A gold coin with a dollar sign.
assets.use: Budget readout (FR-034).

assets.title: Score
assets.description: A five-point star.
assets.use: Score readout (FR-029).

assets.title: Campus satisfaction
assets.description: A smiling face.
assets.use: Campus satisfaction readout (FR-012, FR-034).

assets.title: Simulation clock
assets.description: A clock face with hands at about ten past.
assets.use: Clock readout (FR-034).

assets.title: Restart
assets.description: A circular arrow.
assets.use: Restart session; must confirm (FR-027).

assets.title: Retry level
assets.description: A circular arrow around a small flag.
assets.use: Retry level after being fired (FR-025).

assets.title: Zone table
assets.description: A small table with a header row and three rows.
assets.use: Zone table tab, the text equivalent of the map (FR-035).

assets.title: Campus map
assets.description: A folded map with a location pin.
assets.use: Map tab.

assets.title: Information
assets.description: A lowercase i in a circle.
assets.use: Briefing / model note button (FR-028).

assets.title: Close
assets.description: A cross.
assets.use: Close a dialog or panel.

assets.title: Confirm
assets.description: A check mark.
assets.use: Confirm buttons, e.g. diagnosis submit.

assets.title: Place access point
assets.description: A small access point with a plus sign.
assets.use: Build tool: place AP ($500).

assets.title: Remove equipment
assets.description: A trash can.
assets.use: Remove AP or uplink; 100% refund (FR-003).

assets.title: Buy uplink
assets.description: A cable plug with a plus sign.
assets.use: Build tool: buy or upgrade an uplink.

assets.title: Set channel
assets.description: A tuning dial with tick marks.
assets.use: Channel picker (FR-007).

assets.title: Settings
assets.description: A gear.
assets.use: Settings (auto-pause, reduced motion, audio volume).

assets.title: Sound on
assets.description: A speaker with two sound waves.
assets.use: Mute toggle, unmuted state.

assets.title: Sound off
assets.description: A speaker with a cross.
assets.use: Mute toggle, muted state.

assets.title: Keyboard controls
assets.description: A small keyboard.
assets.use: Keyboard help overlay (FR-036).

assets.title: Dean of IT, neutral
assets.description: The Dean of IT, with silver curls, round glasses, a teal cardigan and an IT lanyard, looking calm.
assets.use: Level briefings and wave previews (FR-028, FR-038).

assets.title: Dean of IT, pleased
assets.description: The Dean of IT smiling broadly with closed, happy eyes and rosy cheeks.
assets.use: Wave passed, level summary and session summary.

assets.title: Dean of IT, concerned
assets.description: The Dean of IT with worried brows, a wavy mouth and a sweat drop.
assets.use: Satisfaction falling near 70%, an old ticket near 90 s, or the maintenance-risk preview.

assets.title: Dean of IT, firing you
assets.description: The Dean of IT frowning and holding up a pink NOTICE slip.
assets.use: Fired review. Keep the metric, value, threshold and cause as text beside it (FR-024).

assets.title: Tree
assets.description: A round leafy campus tree.
assets.use: Decoration on lawn tiles.

assets.title: Moving boxes
assets.description: Three stacked cardboard boxes, the top one labelled ROUTER.
assets.use: Level 2 'Dorm Move-In' decoration.

assets.title: Homecoming pennant
assets.description: A teal triangular pennant reading GO on a short pole.
assets.use: Level 3 'Homecoming' decoration.

assets.title: Coffee mug
assets.description: A steaming network-engineer coffee mug with a Wi-Fi symbol.
assets.use: Session summary or pause screen decoration.

assets.title: RSSI heat-map legend
assets.description: A colour scale from -40 dBm (yellow, strong) to -90 dBm (purple, weak). A bold marker at -67 dBm reads 'covered threshold', and the weak side is hatched for 'not covered'.
assets.use: Heat-map key. Uses a colour-blind-safe scale plus hatching and numbers, never colour alone (FR-006, FR-035).

assets.title: Wall types legend
assets.description: Drywall, brick and concrete wall samples, each labelled with its signal loss in dB.
assets.use: Key for wall types on the map and in briefings. Losses are illustrative (FR-005).

assets.title: 2.4 GHz channel plan legend
assets.description: Channels 1 to 11 drawn as overlapping humps; channels 1, 6 and 11 are solid and do not overlap each other, the rest are dashed.
assets.use: Briefing figure for Level 3 channel planning (FR-007): channels within 4 of each other conflict.

assets.title: Wave passed stamp
assets.description: A tilted rubber-stamp graphic reading "WAVE PASSED" with a double border.
assets.use: Wave review when satisfaction >= 70.0% and no ticket is older than 90 s (FR-024).

assets.title: Fired stamp
assets.description: A tilted rubber-stamp graphic reading "FIRED" with a double border.
assets.use: Wave review when the player is fired. Always show the reason text with it (FR-024).

assets.title: Level complete stamp
assets.description: A tilted rubber-stamp graphic reading "LEVEL COMPLETE" with a double border.
assets.use: Level summary after the third wave review (FR-026).

assets.title: Resolved stamp
assets.description: A tilted rubber-stamp graphic reading "RESOLVED" with a double border.
assets.use: Ticket closed after a correct diagnosis and fix (FR-017).

assets.title: Campus Connect app icon
assets.description: A teal rounded square with white Wi-Fi arcs rising above a small white campus building with an amber door.
assets.use: Favicon, app icon and social preview mark.

assets.title: Campus Connect logo
assets.description: The Campus Connect app icon beside the words Campus Connect and the tagline 'Build the network before the crowd arrives.'
assets.use: Title screen and README header.

assets.title: Level 1: Orientation Week
assets.description: A sunny banner: the campus library with an access point above it, trees and three new students, beside the title Level 1, Orientation Week.
assets.use: Level 1 briefing header (FR-028, FR-031).

assets.title: Level 2: Dorm Move-In
assets.description: An afternoon banner: two brick dorms with moving boxes and students carrying gear, beside the title Level 2, Dorm Move-In.
assets.use: Level 2 briefing header (FR-028, FR-031).

assets.title: Level 3: Homecoming
assets.description: A night-time banner with fireworks over the stadium and the student center, with pennants, beside the title Level 3, Homecoming.
assets.use: Level 3 briefing header (FR-028, FR-031).

assets.title: Campus overview
assets.description: A top-down illustrated campus: the library, a dorm, the student center and the stadium joined by sandy paths, with trees, students and three access points broadcasting dashed coverage circles.
assets.use: Title screen or session summary background. Put the logo and buttons over the open path area.

assets.title: Access point placed
assets.description: Two quick rising triangle-wave blips with a tiny click, like snapping a device into a ceiling mount.
assets.use: Play when an AP is placed or moved (FR-002).

assets.title: Equipment removed
assets.description: The placement blip in reverse: two falling notes.
assets.use: Play when an AP or uplink is removed and refunded (FR-003).

assets.title: Uplink purchased
assets.description: A bright two-note register 'ka-ching' with a shimmer of metallic noise.
assets.use: Play when an uplink is bought (FR-003).

assets.title: Uplink upgraded to 1 Gbps
assets.description: A fast five-note rising arpeggio, like a power-up.
assets.use: Play when a 100 Mbps uplink is upgraded to 1 Gbps (FR-003).

assets.title: Purchase refused
assets.description: Two short low buzzes. Not harsh: it means 'not enough budget', not 'you failed'.
assets.use: Play when a purchase exceeds the remaining budget; show cost and budget as text (FR-004).

assets.title: Channel changed
assets.description: Three rising dial clicks, like turning a tuning knob.
assets.use: Play when an AP's channel is changed (FR-007).

assets.title: Button click
assets.description: A tiny, soft tick.
assets.use: Generic button and menu click. Keep it quiet.

assets.title: Keyboard focus move
assets.description: An even tinier, high blip.
assets.use: Optional cue when the keyboard map cursor moves (FR-036). Off by default is fine.

assets.title: Game paused
assets.description: Two soft descending sine notes.
assets.use: Play when the clock pauses (FR-021). Pair with a visible 'Paused' label.

assets.title: Game resumed
assets.description: Two soft ascending sine notes.
assets.use: Play when the clock resumes (FR-021).

assets.title: Speed set to 2x
assets.description: A quick double blip, the second higher.
assets.use: Play when the clock switches to 2x (FR-021).

assets.title: Session restart
assets.description: A rising whoosh.
assets.use: Play after the player confirms Restart (FR-027).

assets.title: Content error
assets.description: Two flat, dissonant beeps.
assets.use: Play with the visible content-error message when level data fails validation (FR-032).

assets.title: User arrives
assets.description: A soft bubble pop.
assets.use: Play (quietly, rate-limited) as users arrive during a wave (FR-023).

assets.title: New trouble ticket
assets.description: A two-tone help-desk notification chime, played twice.
assets.use: Play when a ticket opens (FR-014). Auto-pause follows by default (FR-022).

assets.title: Correct diagnosis
assets.description: A bright major arpeggio that lands on a bell tone.
assets.use: Play on a correct diagnosis, with the +25 points (FR-017).

assets.title: Not quite
assets.description: Two gentle, descending notes. Encouraging, not punishing: the ticket stays open and no points are lost.
assets.use: Play on a wrong diagnosis, alongside the explanation text (FR-016).

assets.title: Hint revealed
assets.description: A short sparkle of high, quick bell notes.
assets.use: Play when a hint or worked solution is shown (FR-019).

assets.title: Ticket closed
assets.description: A rubber-stamp thud followed by a small chime.
assets.use: Play when a ticket closes after the fix (FR-017); pairs with stamp-resolved.

assets.title: Ticket resolved by network change
assets.description: A single neutral chime: good news, but no points.
assets.use: Play when an undiagnosed ticket auto-closes (FR-017a).

assets.title: Ticket getting old
assets.description: Three urgent but soft pulses.
assets.use: Play once when any ticket passes about 60 s, as a warning before the 90 s firing limit (FR-020, FR-024).

assets.title: Wave starts (campus bell)
assets.description: A ringing electric school bell that stops and decays.
assets.use: Play when a wave of users starts arriving (FR-023).

assets.title: Wave review opens
assets.description: A paper-swoosh, like a report sliding onto a desk.
assets.use: Play when the end-of-wave review appears (FR-024).

assets.title: Wave passed
assets.description: A short, cheerful four-note fanfare.
assets.use: Play when a wave review passes (FR-024).

assets.title: You're fired
assets.description: A droopy, brassy descending 'wah-wah-wah-waaah' with a wobbling last note. Comic, not cruel.
assets.use: Play on the fired review, under the reason text and the Retry level button (FR-024, FR-025).

assets.title: Level complete
assets.description: A longer brass-and-organ victory fanfare ending on a held major chord.
assets.use: Play with the level summary (FR-026).

assets.title: Session complete
assets.description: A grand I-IV-V-I cadence with a bell-like melody and a cymbal swell.
assets.use: Play on the final session summary after Level 3 (FR-026).

assets.title: NOC klaxon (loop)
assets.description: A two-tone network-operations-centre klaxon alternating 600 Hz and 900 Hz. Loops seamlessly.
assets.use: Loop during the Level 3 uplink failure until the player pauses or acts. Keep volume low and stop on pause.

assets.title: On-call pager
assets.description: Three sharp, high pager beeps.
assets.use: Play when a ticket opens while the player is in another panel, or as the on-call page for an outage.

assets.title: Server-room whoop alarm
assets.description: Three rising 'whoop' sirens.
assets.use: Big outage moment: play once when the student center uplink fails (FR-011).

assets.title: Satisfaction falling
assets.description: A soft, repeating two-note warning beep.
assets.use: Play once when campus satisfaction drops below about 75%, before the 70% firing line (FR-024).

assets.title: Uplink fails (power-down)
assets.description: A falling power-down whine with electrical crackles, like equipment dying.
assets.use: Play the instant a scheduled uplink failure fires (FR-011).

assets.title: Dial-up modem handshake
assets.description: A retro modem connecting: dial tone, seven touch-tone digits, ringback, the answer tone, warbly training chirps, a 'bong' and screeching hiss. Synthesised, about 9 seconds.
assets.use: Comedy beat for the Level 2 briefing ('some students brought routers from home'), a loading screen, or an easter egg for a slow zone.

assets.title: Phone dial tone
assets.description: A short telephone dial tone.
assets.use: Help-desk phone flavour, e.g. before a voice complaint plays.

assets.title: Dot-matrix ticket printout
assets.description: A short burst of chattering printer beeps and paper noise.
assets.use: Alternative 'ticket opened' cue with a retro help-desk feel.

assets.title: User: 'My Wi-Fi is so slow!'
assets.description: A higher-pitched student voice in exasperated gibberish whose intonation rises at the end. No real words.
assets.use: Play (at random, rate-limited) when a ticket opens for a slow zone. Keep the ticket text as the real information.

assets.title: User: 'Is the internet down?!'
assets.description: A rising, questioning gibberish complaint ending on a high, indignant note.
assets.use: Play when users lose service in an uncovered zone or a building with its uplink down.

assets.title: User: 'Buffering again...'
assets.description: A low, grumbling gibberish sigh that falls in pitch at the end.
assets.use: Play for Video users in congested zones (Level 2).

assets.title: User yelling 'Hey! Can anyone help?!'
assets.description: A fast, loud, high-pitched gibberish shout.
assets.use: Play when a ticket is older than about 60 s.

assets.title: User wailing 'Nooo, my save!'
assets.description: A long, dramatic gibberish wail that rises and falls.
assets.use: Comedy reaction when a building's uplink fails.

assets.title: Angry crowd murmur (loop)
assets.description: Twelve overlapping gibberish voices muttering and grumbling. Crossfaded to loop.
assets.use: Background bed that fades in as campus satisfaction falls; scale its volume with (100 - satisfaction).

assets.title: Dean of IT: briefing
assets.description: A calm, mid-pitched gibberish voice: an even, matter-of-fact statement.
assets.use: Play when a level briefing opens.

assets.title: Dean of IT: pleased
assets.description: A cheerful gibberish exclamation that rises happily.
assets.use: Play on wave passed or level complete.

assets.title: Dean of IT: 'Hmm...'
assets.description: A slow, doubtful gibberish 'hmm' that ends on a questioning rise.
assets.use: Play when satisfaction is near the 70% line.

assets.title: Dean of IT: 'You're fired!'
assets.description: A stern, emphatic gibberish declaration that drops in pitch at the end.
assets.use: Play on the fired review with the dean-of-it-angry portrait.

assets.title: Title theme (loop)
assets.description: A bright, friendly chiptune theme at 104 BPM in C major: a triangle melody, plucky arpeggios and a light beat. 8 bars, loops seamlessly.
assets.use: Title screen and Level 1 briefing.

assets.title: Build phase (loop)
assets.description: A mellow electric-piano groove at 88 BPM in F major with a soft bass, a shaker and an occasional sine-lead phrase. Unhurried, for thinking.
assets.use: Plays while paused, between waves, and in the zone table. Thinking time is unlimited, so the music should be too.

assets.title: Wave in progress (loop)
assets.description: A driving 128 BPM A-minor track with pulsing bass, a sixteenth-note arpeggio and a buzzy lead. Energetic but not frantic.
assets.use: Plays while a wave is running. Duck or pause it when the game pauses (FR-021).

assets.title: Homecoming march (loop)
assets.description: A marching-band-style loop at 116 BPM in B-flat major, with a brassy lead, oom-pah bass and snare rolls.
assets.use: Level 3 'Homecoming' waves and briefing.

assets.title: Wave review (loop)
assets.description: A slow, reflective 76 BPM pad in C major with a quiet bass and a short sine melody. Calm, for reading the review.
assets.use: Wave review and level summary screens (FR-024, FR-026).

assets.title: Session summary (loop)
assets.description: A warm, triumphant 96 BPM anthem in D major with organ chords, glockenspiel arpeggios and a singing lead.
assets.use: Final session summary and credits.

assets.title: Campus quad ambience (loop)
assets.description: A soft outdoor bed: distant air, light wind and occasional birdsong. Crossfaded to loop.
assets.use: Quiet background under the build phase, or alone when music is turned off.

assets.title: Server closet hum (loop)
assets.description: Mains hum and fan noise from a network closet, with the occasional relay tick. Loops (6 s, whole-cycle hum).
assets.use: Background when the uplink or core-switch panel is open.
